description: Which lanes get a Steve. The JUDGE seam of onboard-v0 — converges the lane-inference distribution into a discrete choice. Reads the seeds/ directory (the set of available steve_seed_* primitive-weight configs) to know what's actually possible to spawn. Apoha: this commits — once judged, the next phase spawns Steves accordingly.

input_refs.description: Reference to the lane-inference this selection resolves.

chosen_lanes.description: Lane slugs selected for Steve spawn. ≥1 required — onboarding always seeds at least one lane.

rationale.description: Why these lanes, why not the others. Names the apoha.
